title: Growth phase: exponential to long-term stationary in LB (GSE152619)
caption: One K-12 culture in LB sampled from mid-exponential to long-term stationary phase. Along the phase axis the samples move from the exponential end to the stationary end; the late and long-term stationary samples fall back toward the middle (p(stationary) about 0.02).

title: Growth phase in a biofilm: depth bins and a planktonic time course (GSE197541)
caption: Five K-12 biofilms (b1 to b5) cut into bins by depth, next to a planktonic time course of the same strain (7.6 h to 28 h). Colour is p(stationary): the deepest bins (about 700 µm and more) and the 25 h and 28 h cultures are called stationary. The Study tab lists the samples by their GEO titles.

title: Growth phase: REL606 from 3 h to two weeks of starvation (GSE67402, TEST)
caption: E. coli B REL606 in glucose-limited Davis minimal medium, sampled from 3 h to 336 h. This study is in the TEST split: the model never saw it in training.

title: Growth phase: the large 96-well study (GSE206047)
caption: Over a thousand circuit-characterisation samples in M9 + casamino acids at 5 h, 8 h and 18 h. Its weight on the stationary label is capped in training, because it would otherwise supply most of that class.

title: Medium: BW25113 in LB and in M63 (GSE136101)
caption: One K-12 strain grown in LB and in M63 minimal medium. The two media sit at opposite ends of the medium axis (p(minimal) 0 and 1).

title: Lab strain: eight strains from five lineages (GSE150501)
caption: K-12, B and W lab strains alongside pathogenic isolates (UPEC, EHEC, EAEC), all in the same minimal medium at mid-exponential phase. The lab-strain axis separates the lab lineages from the isolates.

title: Withheld study: 179 cold and osmotic shock samples (GSE224463)
caption: This study was withheld from training and only projected into the atlas. It shows how a large new study lands among the training samples.

title: Case study: UPEC isolates (GSE128997)
caption: Clinical uropathogenic isolates, one of the v1 case studies kept in TEST.

title: Case study: aerobic and microaerobic growth (GSE189154, TEST)
caption: K-12 in minimal medium under aerobic and microaerobic conditions, one of the v1 case studies kept in TEST.

title: Worked example: GSE271069 (the inGEST tutorial study)
caption: The study of the worked example in examples/ of the repository: K-12 sampled through growth into late stationary phase. The transition samples sit between the two ends of the phase axis.
